seoTitle: Riverside Unified 2026–27 Calendar: Key Dates & PDF
seoDescription: Riverside Unified (RUSD) 2026–27 calendar with the 7th-grade start date, grade-specific final days, holidays, major recesses, official PDF, and ICS download.
heroSummary: Riverside Unified classes begin Monday, August 10, 2026. Seventh graders start earlier, on Friday, August 7. High school and 7th grade students finish May 26, while elementary and 8th grade students finish May 27.
verificationBadgeText: Reviewed August 14, 2026 · Source: Riverside Unified School District
calendarNotes: Seventh grade starts August 7, before general classes begin August 10. Parent/teacher conferences run November 5–6, when elementary students are not in session. Elementary minimum days fall October 30, February 19, and May 14. High school and 7th grade end May 26; elementary and 8th grade end May 27.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Riverside Unified start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Classes begin on Monday, August 10, 2026. The first day for 7th grade is Friday, August 7, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Are elementary students in school during RUSD parent/teacher conferences?
calendarFaqs.a: No. RUSD lists parent/teacher conferences for November 5–6, 2026, with elementary students not in session.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Riverside Unified Spring Recess in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess runs Monday, March 29 through Friday, April 2, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Riverside Unified in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: High school and 7th grade end May 26, 2027. Elementary and 8th grade end May 27, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Riverside Unified have the same calendar for all schools?
calendarFaqs.a: RUSD publishes a districtwide Calendar at a Glance, but some dates apply only to certain grade levels or school types. Individual schools may also publish campus-specific events, testing dates, bell schedules, and other schedule changes.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I get the official Riverside Unified calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official RUSD Calendar at a Glance PDF linked in the downloads section. MySchoolDates also provides a separate one-time ICS file for the reviewed dates on this page.

customSections.label: What Changed from 2025–26?
customSections.content: Compared with 2025–26, RUSD starts and ends earlier, while Spring Recess moves later.

groups.label: Changes
items: General classes begin August 10, one day earlier than in 2025–26.
Both grade-level ending dates move two days earlier: May 26 for high school and 7th grade, and May 27 for elementary and 8th grade.
Spring Recess moves from March 23–27 in 2025–26 to March 29–April 2 in 2026–27.

comparisonTitle: RUSD 2026–27 Calendar Compared With Inland Empire Districts
comparisonSummary: RUSD's general start date is August 10, later than San Bernardino City Unified and Fontana Unified but earlier than Moreno Valley Unified. Its grade-specific May 26–27 ending dates are earlier than the June ending dates in San Bernardino and Moreno Valley. Fontana's final student day is May 27, matching RUSD's later grade-specific end date.
comparisonFooterText: Dates follow each district's reviewed 2026–27 calendar. RUSD's final-day row preserves its two grade-specific ending dates.
